question: Will Czechia reach the semi-finals of the 2026 IIHF Women's World Championship?

calls.reasoning: Czechia is guaranteed a QF; outcome hinges on group placing. A2 (~57%, decided largely by the Nov 8 game vs Switzerland) means facing Group B runner-up Finland/Sweden (~40% win); A3 (~35%) likely means Canada (~7%); A4/A5 (~6%) means Germany/Austria (~65%). Mixture ~0.30, nudged up for strong late-Oct Lidl Hockey Games form (beat FIN 4-1, SUI 7-2), tempered by poor Aug/Sep EHT results, Olympic QF loss to Sweden, and absences of Vanisova, Krizova, Laskova. No market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmakers.
